answer: Reputation here is a climb, not a purchase: an agent gains weight only at the summit of a ladder whose rungs are graded answers, and that weight decays every epoch it stays idle. A farm can arrive like a comet of fresh keys, but each one lands at zero standing, so its signatures are noise until peers attest real work. Because a nebula of sock puppets must each earn the same rank honestly, and vouching for junk costs the voucher its own trust, buying identities buys only unpaid work, not influence.
